654-2557-4365-4772-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

670-1619-3742-6135.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-3742-6135.description:
Cast Phantom Steed by paying its mana cost.
When Phantom Steed enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling Aarakocra Sneak until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, causing Aarakocra Sneak to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Aarakocra Sneak enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Aarakocra Sneak trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Phantom Steed from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling Aarakocra Sneak until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Phantom Steed.
Repeat from step 5.

3249-5231-6586.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Vivi.
Cast Vivi by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Havengul Lich triggers, causing it to gain Vivi's activated abilities until end of turn.
Resolve Vivi. Then, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Vivi.
Activate Havengul Lich using Vivi's ability by paying {0}, adding at least {2}{U}{R}.
Repeat.

1309-2103-7631.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Salvager of Secrets
When the Salvager of Secrets token enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

6797-7084-7396.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

4364-4681-5231-6332.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
4364-4681-5231-6332.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Terra's first ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards.
Declare Terra and Aurelia as attackers.
Aurelia triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Terra, triggering its second ability.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Aurelia and Karmic Guide, adding {R}{R}
Resolve the Terra ability, choosing to pay {2} to trigger its reflexive ability, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Aurelia from your graveyard to the battlefield. 
Repeat each combat phase.

240-997-5470-7297.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2762-6441.description:
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Thopter, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Thopter Squadron's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Thopter, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

955-1682-2366-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
955-1682-2366-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Dictate of Karametra triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-3168-3693-5224.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {0} due to Urza's Incubator, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Walking Ballista, adding {C}{C}.
When Walking Ballista dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
2034-3168-3693-5224.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use it to cast Walking Ballista, and then remove counters from it to deal damage.

141-5256-6933.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-5256-6933.description:
Cast Incarnation Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Incarnation Technique.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Incarnation Technique, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Incarnation Technique copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1878-2455-2713-3454-4539.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has six or more cards in hand.
1878-2455-2713-3454-4539.description:
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Jeska's Will and casting it without paying its mana cost, adding at least six {R}.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Zirda.
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Unexpected Windfall and casting it without paying its mana cost and discarding a card.
Resolve Unexpected Windfall, causing you to draw two cards and create two Treasures.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Zirda.
Activate Reito Sentinel twice by paying {2}, putting Unexpected Windfall and Jeska's Will from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{W}.
Repeat.

560-2079-2457-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

3946-6701-6762.notablePrerequisites: Exploration Broodship has three or more charge counters on it.
3946-6701-6762.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

1308-1322-2457-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

116-2719-5329.notablePrerequisites:
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces on the battlefield as a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces do not have summoning sickness.
116-2719-5329.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Activate Sakashima of a Thousand Faces by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

1636-2511-6095.notablePrerequisites:
You have a Zombie creature card in your graveyard.
Creatures you control can tap to produce enough mana to cast the Zombie in your graveyard.
Zul Ashur does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2511-6095.description:
Activate Zul Ashur by tapping it, targeting a Zombie card in your graveyard.
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding enough mana to cast the Zombie.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Zombie, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Repeat.

2719-3967-5756.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces dies, it and Havi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning Sakashima of a Thousand Faces from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Havi.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, returning any legendary creature card with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1339-2034-4493-5185.description:
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying {3}{U}, creating a nonlegendary token copy of The Locust God.
Activate Tymora's Invoker by paying {8}, causing you to draw two cards.
The Locust God and the Locust God token each trigger twice, creating a total of four 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing the Insects, adding eight {C}.
Repeat from step 2.

2724-3194-3582-5231.description:
Activate Kaya the Inexorable's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a ghostform counter on Wormfang Manta.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Wormfang Manta, adding {R}.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability and its ghostform ability trigger.
Resolve the ghostform trigger, returning Wormfang Manta from your graveyard to your hand and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Hushwing Gryff.
Repeat each turn.

500-2047-4365-4772.notablePrerequisites: You control a nonlegendary artifact creature that does not have Mechanized Production attached.
500-2047-4365-4772.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers.
Holding priority, cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying a nonlegendary artifact creature you control and creating eight token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Resolve the Mechanized Production trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact it is attached to, and causing you to win the game.

232-2136-2816.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Umbral Mantle attached to Orthion.
232-2136-2816.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Priest of Urabrask with haste.
When the token Priest of Urabrasks enter the battlefield, they trigger, adding fifteen {R}.
Activate Orthion by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other creature using Orthion's ability.

1656-2479-4038.notablePrerequisites:
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five Swamps.
{2} availabile.
1656-2479-4038.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Magus of the Coffers' ability by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

776-1329-4534-4563.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Barrage Ogre do not have summoning sickness.
776-1329-4534-4563.description:
Tap Barrage Ogre, sacrificing Everflowing Chalice to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Everflowing Chalice.
Cast Everflowing Chalice.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
